name: Cahier
thesis: Un rapport analytique manipulable : source, définition et valeurs exactes suivent une lecture documentaire continue.

composition.analysis: source strip, horizontal calculation form, chart plus exact table, method disclosures
composition.dashboard: three ruled plot/table report sections, scope and provenance alongside
composition.assistant: contextual question, selected medication identity and fact table, dated source, temporary conversation and next-question composer

actions.tertiary: underlined text or quiet text button

charts.type: HTML horizontal bars, exact HTML labels

components.confirmation: native dialog with Rester / Abandonner; Escape preserves in-page values
components.feedback: inline live status; source errors and empty state examples in optional system specimen

states.loading: short local Calculate state; obsolete results removed
states.error: optional system specimen only; explicit example
states.empty: changed configuration hides old results; reset assistant yields empty context; optional system example
states.save: explicit simulation message; never claims persistence

dashboard: all/A/B filter updates all affected figures from fixed fixture presets

responsive.1000px: narrow report margins, dashboard plots stack inside each section
responsive.760px: main outcome stacks; source strip reduces to two columns; dashboard context follows report
responsive.480px: single-column dashboard plots, full-width action targets, stacked composer, 44px controls
responsive.320px: two-column concise configuration; wrapped source metadata; exact tables contain their scrolling

motion.duration: 160ms color state change; 350ms local calculation demonstration
motion.reducedMotion: remove transitions, animation and smooth scrolling

data.analysis: TEST CP6 · Observations synthétiques, cp6-v1.csv v1, SYNTHETIC_CP6_REVIEW
data.assistant: local responses.json selected ABIP 15 mg, 30 film-coated tablets, recorded public price 372.00 MAD, AMMPS observation 2026-10-18

qa.handoff: root performs browser and responsive inspection

tradeoffs: Longer reading flow than a persistent configuration rail
Document tabs consume less space but expose fewer global resource destinations
Restrained serif headings create a report voice; controls and data stay in familiar sans
Dashboard prioritizes inspection and comparability over freeform tile arrangement

success.behavior: Persistent contextual text naming the confirmed operation and saved revision; never inferred from Calculate or a local simulation

warning.behavior: Explicit consequence and next action, color accompanied by text

validation.behavior: Linked summary and field-specific instruction; aria-invalid and aria-describedby; retain current input

proposedFeedback.unknownOutcome: Explain uncertainty; read-only verification before explicit retry, no automatic mutation replay

proposedChartSystem.continuousScale: Light neutral through the primary data hue; explicit numeric legend and units
proposedChartSystem.redundancy: Text labels, line dashes/point markers and exact tables; do not rely on hue alone
proposedChartSystem.scope: Proposal for all existing chart types; the HTML specimens demonstrate bars only, plus exact tables/missingness. No production palette adopted.

centralVerification: REVIEW.md, browser-verification.json and review-verification.json; candidate remains unapproved
